newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Peter Oakes said Thursday he cut his earnings estimates for fast-food giant McDonald's Corp to by $0.02 a share to $2.50 for 1997 and by $0.05 to $2.85 for 1998. He rates McDonald's a long-term buy.

-- Oakes said the stock has been under pressure based on media reports about a proposed McDonald's price promotion that would feature a sandwich for $0.55 when a customer buys a soft drink and french fries.
-- McDonald's recent U.S. price promotions were done at the local level, Oakes said.
-- "The proposed effort will redirect existing efforts but with a considerably greater impact (the message gets out when nationally sponsored)," Oakes said.
-- He added that McDonald's domestic base is poised for a positive same-store sales performance in the first quarter, following a year-and-a-half slump.
-- He added he expects McDonald's international same store sales, which "retreated for each of the last three quarters," to show gains starting in the second half of 1997.
-- "In our view, this improvement will be sufficient to favorably impact investor sentiment, resulting in an improved relative valuation and higher stock price," Oakes said.
